Class LessonList

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonList
public class LessonList extends Object

Title: LessonList Class.

Description: Stores a collection of Lesson objects without a fixed size limit. The collection may represent all lessons, the lessons belonging to one contributor, or a selected set.

This class supports the contributor user stories by allowing lessons to be added, found updated, removed, retrieved from the database and searched

Persistent list operations use the Database class to retrieve saved lessons The design can support later project phases that require searching, viewing collections and producing subsets of lessons

Author:
Ahmad El-Merhaby
